withReentrantMainWriteLock wraps the git commit-on-main + git merge-into-worktree critical section in commitInitCheckMetadataAndMergeMain. Lock held across both steps so concurrent sessions cannot commit to main between the metadata commit and the merge, closing the race that previously produced divergent index.json leading to merge conflicts. Reentrant variant used: lock released in finally even when the critical section throws. Smoke drives the reconcile end-to-end under the lock with successful exit. main-write-lock-smoke continues to pass (lock acquisition + release-on-throw coverage pre-existing).
